displayName.zh_CN: 笔记转 draw.io 流程图

description.default: Convert the current note into a draw.io flowchart generated by a cloud LLM (OpenAI-compatible API), saved as a .drawio file and embedded via the drawio plugin.
description.zh_CN: 一键将当前笔记通过云端大模型（OpenAI 兼容接口）生成为 draw.io 流程图，保存为 .drawio 文件并通过 drawio 插件嵌入笔记。
